content.thinking: Claude writes: הדף הזה מציג את מחשבון ההשקעה במדד S&P 500, עם שדות לסכום היום, להפקדה החודשית ולשנים, ותוצאה של 84,184 ₪ לעומת 86,492 ₪ שנתפס בירוק.
The second screen is cluttered, and the list on the right shows the big banks taking the most, including a company I don't recognise, so I'll set the left side aside for now.
Screens 4 and 5 show more red negative figures for funds, plus Hebrew bank rows with one missing value, and the dense grey text is hard to follow. I'll take one more screen next.

Sixth screen: I understood the sentence about negotiating better bank and brokerage rates, so I'll ask at the bank. The next chart on what affects your net money is more than I can take in right now, so I'm stopping here.

input.answer: I didn't decide anything. With 500 a month for ten years the page says I'd be left with about 84,000 at that "אינטראקטיב" company I've never heard of, but only about 68,000–71,000 at Leumi, Hapoalim or Discount. So I'll ask you, and then go to my bank to bargain like the page says, rather than open anything at a company I don't know.

A long list of English fund names with coloured tags and red minus signs. I couldn't tell which one is 'the fund'
Long paragraphs in small grey letters under each company. I gave up on them
